plan.title: Send reminders only to non-bidding vendors

steps.note: the API built this case's state
Use an RFQ stage rather than the default auction stage.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one product so the RFQ can be published.
Invite exactly two vendors so one can bid and one can remain pending.
Have one invited vendor submit a bid, leaving the other vendor pending.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Open the Send Reminders drawer from the project menu.
Verify that exactly one vendor remains pending after the other vendor bid.

args.goal: send the reminder from the open Send Reminders drawer to the one pending offer submission and stop when the buyer screen shows the send confirmation

steps.note: Perform the drawer's confirmation action, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Assert that the reminder send produced a success confirmation.
